name: Cipher
description: Ciphers are uncommon and often misunderstood individuals with extraordinary mental abilities. Like priests and wizards they're able to cast devastating spells, however, ciphers manifest spells through mental prowess alone.
weapons: Club, Crossbow, Dagger, Mace, Shortsword, Shortbow, Spear

traits.bonus: Add a melee or ranged weapon to your proficiency list
Gain advantage on casting one spell you know
+2 to Strength, Dexterity, or Charisma stat
Choose a talent or +2 points to distribute to stats

specials.name: Focused Mind
specials.description: You gain +1 to melee and ranged attacks. In addition, add half your level to these rolls (round down).

spellcasting.name: Psionics
spellcasting.casting: To cast a cipher spell you know, make a spellcasting check by rolling 1d20 + your Charisma modifier. The DC to successfully cast a spell is 10 + the spell's tier.
spellcasting.starting: You know two tier 1 spells of your choice from the cipher spell list as well as the Telekinesis spell (cipher version).
spellcasting.progression: Each time you gain a level, you choose new cipher spells to learn according to the Cipher Spells Known table below.

spell_mishap: If you roll a natural 1 on your spellcasting check you can't cast that spell again until you successfully complete a rest. You must also roll on the Cipher Mishap table corresponding to the spell's tier (see below).

mishap_table.name: Mishap Tier 1-2
mishap_table.roll_1: Devastation! Roll twice and combine effects (reroll 1)
mishap_table.roll_3: Broken mind! You can't cast the spell again for a week
mishap_table.roll_4: The horror! You scream uncontrollably for 3 rounds
mishap_table.roll_5: Psychic surge! You glow bright blue for 10 rounds, ADV
mishap_table.roll_6: Unstable mind! Disadvantage on spell casting for 3 rounds

mishap_table.name: Mishap Tier 3-4
mishap_table.roll_1: Devastation! Roll twice and combine effects (reroll 1)
mishap_table.roll_2: Psionic blast! You and all within near take 2d6 damage
mishap_table.roll_3: Brain hemorrhage! Pass DC15 CON or take 4 INT, WIS, and CHR damage
mishap_table.roll_4: Stupefaction! You lose the ability to cast spells for 10 rounds
mishap_table.roll_5: Madness! DC12 WIS or descend into mad raving for 2d6 rounds
mishap_table.roll_6: Feebleminded! Disadvantage on spell casting for 3 hours

mishap_table.name: Mishap Tier 5
mishap_table.roll_1: Devastation! Roll twice and combine effects (reroll 1)
mishap_table.roll_2: Psychic vampire! Drain 1d4 CHR from all within near, take damage equal to drain
mishap_table.roll_3: Mind over matter! Attacks against you deal 2x damage
mishap_table.roll_4: Déjà vu! Self spells target random creature within near
mishap_table.roll_5: What lurks beyond the veil! DC15 WIS check madness 1d4 hours
mishap_table.roll_6: Mental reset! Disadvantage on spell casting for 24 hours
